title: Using Claude Opus 5.5 as your daily driver for knowledge work
summary: Opus 5.5 is now the recommended model for everyday knowledge work such as research, memos, spreadsheets, and decks, and it is the default on Pro, Max, Ultra, and Team plans. At Medium effort (the default), it matches or beats Opus 5 at High and is stronger at financial analysis and reading charts. Fewer steps and less editing can offset its higher per-token price, and the guide recommends asking for finished files, defining done, and starting at Medium effort.

title: Your apps can now open in Claude, and Claude can work in them
summary: Partner apps can now embed directly in Claude, opening beside chat or full screen, and Claude can edit open pages, rows, and files in them with actions approved like connector actions. The feature is rolling out on web and desktop for all plans, starting with Asana, Canva, Notion, and Confluence, and apps can be pinned to the sidebar. Built on the open MCP Apps extension, with app tools and embedded sites in public preview, it reduces tab switching by letting Claude work inside existing tools.

title: Linked billing on the Claude Platform
summary: This beta feature lets third-party platforms bill customers' Claude API usage without sharing API keys, since customers link their existing Claude Platform org and usage bills directly to them. Customers approve each platform, set monthly spend limits, view spend in Console, and can unlink at any time, while platforms skip building metering and invoicing and can choose per request who pays. The trade-off is that requests run in the platform's org, so customer IP allowlists, encryption keys, and retention settings do not apply.

title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
summary: Self-hosted Claude Managed Agents are in private beta and can run in your own cloud or on-prem, with the full service (harness, credentials, and session history) hostable rather than just the sandbox. Model requests can route to Anthropic, a cloud provider, or your own gateway, with credentials kept out of the sandbox, network access limited to allowed hosts, and every tool call recorded. Activity can be exported via OpenTelemetry, and session history stays in your own database.

title: How Curative is building a national provider network with agents on Claude
summary: Health insurer Curative uses a hierarchy of Claude agents to negotiate and sign provider contracts, with an Opus agent managing each deal, a Sonnet rate reviewer, a Haiku judge checking outbound messages, and a CEO approving non-standard pricing. Reported results include roughly 2,000-2,400 contracts per week versus 2,100 for all of 2025, and claims dispute responses falling from about 90 days to under 30 minutes. The company estimates the network would otherwise take about 30 years to build, and its lessons include limited initial authority, isolated runs, and logging and auditing.

title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
summary: Claude for Manufacturing is a plugin with 17 skills and four connectors (Autodesk Fusion, Infor, Microsoft 365, and Oracle NetSuite) that drafts quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests, with multi-step skills pausing for human review. Infor is releasing its own plugin so Claude can act in Infor, such as releasing POs, per user permissions and with approval. It targets manual data entry, which 79% of manufacturers report per a 2025 MLC survey, and is available on Team and Enterprise plans.
